If you are a flexible, relational, open-minded self-starter who is passionate about using Christian camping as a life-changing way to heal hurts, break down walls, and share Jesus, then we have a place for you in Brazil.

The Need

About 75 percent of Brazilians identify as Catholic. In the last three decades Brazil has also grown to be the largest Pentecostal nation in the world. Only four percent of the 200 million people claim to be non-Pentecostal Evangelical believers. In Southern Brazil, less than two percent of people identify as Christians. In 2015, the nation of Brazil entered into a widespread economic crisis. The financial recession is real, crime is high, and the overall morale, at times, can be very low. We are praying that God will use this difficulty to soften hearts, open eyes to the Gospel, and give many hope in desperate times. Will you join us?

We seek individuals to partner with missionaries and Brazilian nationals to share the gospel, plant and multiply local churches, train leaders, and ultimately, assist Brazilians to continue fulfilling the Great Commission by sending out their own people as missionaries.

The Impact

Camp ministries offer a respite and retreat for children, young people, couples, and families whose lives are often plagued by neglect, poverty, and heartbreak. Beyond the fun, camp ministries can help introduce youth to Jesus Christ, encourage healthy families and marriages, and offer spiritual renewal for believers and church leaders. If you are passionate about using Christian camping as a life-changing way to heal hurts, break down walls, and share Jesus, then we have a place for you. Don’t wait; the fields are ripe for the harvest.

Criamos ainda a primeira Inteligência Artificial para gestão pública, a Dara, que foi premiada duas vezes em 1° lugar como a melhor solução do Brasil para cidades inteligentes. A IPM é formada por mais de 600 pessoas apaixonadas pela inovação e transformação digital das cidades. Somos movidos por grandes desafios e pelo nosso impacto, e temos um sonho maior ainda: transformar o futuro de cidades e pessoas através do melhor da tecnologia.

Estamos crescendo Brasil afora, e sempre lançando novas soluções que estão transformando o futuro de pessoas e cidades. Nos últimos anos, conquistamos diversos prêmios e certificações da consultoria internacional Great Place to Work (GPTW). Em 2022, fomos reconhecidos como um dos 5 melhores times de RH do Brasil; em 2023, figuramos entre as melhores empresas para trabalhar pela segunda vez no ranking Mulher e pela primeira vez no ranking LGBTI+; e em 2024, recebemos pela 5ª vez consecutiva a certificação de uma das melhores empresas para trabalhar. Aqui, valorizamos a inovação, colaboração, sentimento de dono, foco no cliente, atitude descomplicada e ágil, e a mão-na-massa. Por isso, estamos sempre em busca de talentos tão motivados pelo nosso propósito e impacto quanto nós somos, que sejam apaixonados pela tecnologia, e que tenham muita garra para fazer acontecer.

Venha construir o futuro da gestão pública na IPM!

title: Vertriebsleiter (m/w/d) für den Immobilienvertrieb
description:
PlanetHome - Als einer der führenden Immobilienvermittler in Deutschland und Österreich sind unsere Kernkompetenzen die Vermittlung und Finanzierung von Wohnimmobilien. Im Rahmen unseres Geschäftsmodells fokussieren wir uns dabei auf die enge Zusammenarbeit mit Banken, Versicherungen und Finanzdienstleistern, um deren Angebot für ihre Kunden rund um die Immobilie optimal zu ergänzen.

Starte mit uns durch – wir suchen für den Süden und Nord-Osten Deutschlands einen

Vertriebsleiter (m/w/d) für den Immobilienvertrieb

Warum Du zu uns kommen solltest:

  • Ein Vertriebsleiter bei Planethome ist nicht nur ein erfolgreicher, erfahrener Immobilienmakler mit einem individuellen Umsatzziel und Vertriebsauftrag, sondern auch in seiner Zusatzrolle als Vertriebsleiter Coach und Führungskraft für bis zu fünf Immobilienmakler. Dafür bekommt der Vertriebsleiter --- additiv zu seiner Vergütung und Provision als Immobilienmakler --- eine Teamumsatzbeteiligung. Als Vertriebsleiter vertritt er den Regionalleiter und die Region gegenüber internen und externen Partnern.
  • Flexibilität im Alltag und unbegrenzter Urlaub – Du entscheidest, wann und wieviel Du arbeitest, um Deine Ziele zu erreichen. Home-Office und mobiles Arbeiten sind jederzeit flexibel möglich.
  • Modernes Equipment – Ob Smartphone oder Notebook, wir sorgen dafür, dass Du umfassend mobil ausgestattet bist. Bei entsprechender Leistung bieten wir Dir einen attraktiven Firmenwagen.
  • Keine klassische Kaltakquise – Unser hochprofessionelles Netzwerk versorgt Dich mit ausreichend Leads, sodass Du auf klassische Kaltakquise verzichten kannst.
  • Jahrzehntelange erfolgreiche Unternehmensgeschichte – Wir bieten Dir ein stabiles und krisenfestes Umfeld in der Immobilienbranche.
  • Weiterbildung – Unsere PlanetHome Academy unterstützt Dich bei Deiner beruflichen Entwicklung.
  • Kollegialität – Bei uns zählt Teamarbeit. Ellenbogen-Mentalität hat bei uns keinen Platz.
  • Karriere – Wir belohnen Erfolg mit großartigen Incentives und haben Deine Entwicklung im Blick: Viele unserer Führungskräfte haben bei uns Karriere gemacht.

Deine Aufgaben, unsere Unterstützung:

  • Teamentwicklung: Du führst als Vertriebsleiter disziplinarisch ein Team von ca. 5 Immobilienmaklern, coachst und motivierst Deine Mitarbeiter, um gemeinsam erfolgreich zu sein.
  • Reporting: Du berichtest in beiden Rollen an den Regionalleiter und stellst sicher, dass Du deine eigenen Ziele erfüllst und Dein Team seinen Teamumsatz erreicht.
  • Verkaufsprozess: Du übernimmst als Immobilienmakler die Akquise, vermarktest über uns und begleitest den effizienten Prozess bis zum Notartermin.
  • Dein Netzwerk: Ein umfassendes Partnernetzwerk aus namhaften Banken, Finanzdienstleistungs- und Versicherungsinstituten ist die Quelle für deine Leads. Durch aktives, vertrauensbildendes Networking baust du kontinuierlich eine Objektpipeline auf, die dich mit ausreichend Leads versorgt.
  • Support zum Start: Die ersten Wochen unterstützen wir Dich mit einem gezielten Online-Ausbildungsprogramm in unserer hauseigenen Academy.
  • Training on the Job: Dein Team und erfahrene Kollegen nehmen Dich mit zu Kundenterminen und zeigen Dir alles Wichtige, damit Du schnell in die Erfolgsspur findest.

Warum Du zu uns passt:

  • Vertriebserfahrung: Du bist seit mehreren Jahren als Immobilienmakler erfolgreich und brennst für den Vertrieb.
  • Führungserfahrung: Du hast bereits ein Team erfolgreich geführt und weißt, wie man Mitarbeiter motiviert und fördert oder möchtest dich perspektivisch in der Führungsrolle weiterentwickeln.
  • Kundenkontakt: Es fällt Dir leicht, empathisch und individuell zu beraten. Das Entwickeln und Pflegen von Netzwerken ist eine Deiner Stärken.
  • Immobilienaffinität: Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrungen mit der Vermittlung, der Verwaltung oder dem Verkauf von Immobilien gesammelt. Aber auch Qualifikationen aus anderen Vertriebszweigen sind willkommen (z.B. aus Bank, Automobilverkauf, Vermögens- und Finanzierungsberatung etc.).
  • Kollegialität: Uns liegt daran, nicht nur gute, sondern auch menschliche und nette Teams zu bilden. Gemeinsam erreicht man Ziele besser als allein.
  • Eigensteuerung: Bei uns bist Du angestellt, aber wir schätzen Teams, die unternehmerisch denken. Es fällt Dir leicht, Dich selbst zu managen und Du hast stets ein Auge für mögliche Entwicklungspotenziale.

title: Staff MacOS Software Engineer
description:
A Day in the Life

This position will be part of the Fireware team, WatchGuard Engineering Department.

Within the team, you will be responsible for the development of the macOS client applications, interacting with the establishment of secure VPN tunnel, communication to backend infrastructure supporting various authentication methods and securely storing configuration, licensing and certificates. Furthermore, it may be necessary for the client to interact with interception layer modules, both the interception modules for file and process operations, and network operations. Acting as support for the developments on the Windows and Linux platforms of these modules.

You will be dedicated to the evolutionary maintenance and to the resolution of both customer and internal incidents of macOS client application. You will also be engaging with product management and customer support to understand customer feedback and needs.

You will demonstrate effective technical leadership, take decisions, and drive the development activities in the right direction. It is possible that in your role you may be involved with more than one project at the same time, and being the owner means that you must assume responsibility for what you and your teams are doing.

You will coordinate with the QAs team for functional validation and definition of the test checklists.

Additionally, you will work on the documentation of the modules, resolution of technical doubts and cost estimates of the new features to be developed.

30/60/90 Plan

  1. At 30 days: This is a training/onboarding period. You will be trained in the tools, systems, methods and the way the team works in the Fireware team. It will include access to development tools, hardware resources, and development repositories. You will be involved in the daily tasks of the team and participate in all Agile ceremonies.
  2. At 60 days: Continue training/onboarding and begin functional development. You will have development environments fully operational. You will be prepared to develop fully functional production code. You will start working on customer requirements and functional development, supervised by a team senior member or cross-team member.
  3. At 90 days: Must be able to develop functional production modules of the client application based on requirements specified by the Product Owner and Development Manager utilizing the development pipelines, repositories, and work streams identified during the training phases. Must work in an integrated way with the QA of the team for functional validation.

About the Position

This position is for experienced macOS staff software engineer who want to join a multi-disciplinary team of expert developers in security protections, to work on the generation of solutions that both protect our customers and offer attractive functionality to them, both in the products of large account, corporate products and end-user products.

The right candidate for this position should have advanced knowledge of software development and years of experience in multidisciplinary teams. Previous experience in a similar position is preferred.

It serves as the technical lead for the client application development within the project and mentor other engineers and continue to develop command over all aspects of delivering high-quality software (design, documentation, unit tests, code reviews, security, deployment, monitoring, maintenance, etc.)

It is desired to have knowledge and experience in working on agile methodologies, which allow a quick response to our clients.

It will interact both with the rest of the team's developers, work closely with UX/UI team members, Product Owner and Engineering Manager.

This role reports directly to the Engineering Manager. If you are looking for a challenge and are enthusiastic, self-motivated and want to grow as a developer of security solutions, WatchGuard has the perfect fit for you.

Position Responsibilities

  • Requirements analysis, design, and implementation of new features.
  • Design and implementation of proof of concepts and tests.
  • Code review, debugging, bug fixing.
  • Follow agile development methodologies.
  • Highly qualified teammates to work with.
  • Continuous update and learning of new OS features.
  • Continuous learning and continuous technical knowledge improvement.
  • Participate in the interesting technological projects and continuous challenges.
  • Taking ownership and decisions.
  • Showing initiative and commitment.
  • Maintain an excellent working environment.

Skills and Qualifications

  • Knowledge of Swift / Objective-C / Python / Bash programming languages.
  • Knowledge of programming on macOS GUI applications, Kernels Extensions (KEXT), System Extension (SEXT), and Network Extensions and the communication with the user space.
  • Knowledge on kernel module debugging techniques.
  • Knowledge of macOS starting from macOS 10.10 (Yosemite) and above.
  • Knowledge on multiplatform development.
  • Knowledge of agile methodologies (preferable knowledge of SCRUM)
  • Knowledge of version control GIT (and other repo technologies)
  • Knowledge of macOS development tools: XCode
  • Additional knowledge about other programming languages
  • Additional knowledge on continuous integrations
  • Additional knowledge on other platforms: Linux and Windows
  • Knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, HTTP/S & DNS)
  • You should also be able to communicate clearly in written and spoken English.

Experience

  • 10+ years of experience
  • Working as a part of a team with shared goals.
  • Working on agile methodologies

title: Accounting Specialist/Analyst
description:
If you have fallen and risen, if you have broken and fixed, if you have dreamt and built, then you have grit. Then we speak the same language. Welcome to the Wolfpack.

About CloudWalk:

We are one of the fastest growing fintechs on the planet. We kick ass. A unicorn, with millions of happy customers, a hardcore team, and hundreds of millions in funding and revenue. But not your typical startup.

We build and learn, fast, and we want the hackers, the artists, the crafters - join the Wolfpack!

About the position:

We are seeking a high-potential and self-motivated Accounting Specialist or Analyst to join our accounting team, reporting to the Accounting Manager. In this role, you will support our fast-growing, ever-evolving business and become a key contributor to the close processes, financial audits, internalization of accounting functions, review of technical accounting transactions, as well as other critical responsibilities. This is a unique opportunity for career development (e.g., work directly with senior leaders and external partners) and learning (e.g. increasing complexity of geography, products and business models, automation, process improvement), considering the role’s company-wide exposure.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Directly contribute to the company's financial stability and growth by working on high-impact financial close processes including month-end, quarter-end, and annual close, ensuring accuracy and compliance with tight deadlines.
  • Prepare accurate journal entries, analyze results and fluctuations, and reconcile general ledger accounts in accordance with Bacen GAAP and IFRS.
  • Work closely with our third-party accounting & tax support staff in the US & Brazil.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for semi-annual audits and all compliance matters, incl. audit, tax and regulatory filings.
  • Support the consolidation process for multiple entities.
  • Be a key user of SAP S4/Hana.
  • Research and interpret accounting treatment and apply guidance to corporate accounting matters, vendor contracts, new transactions, and other related areas.
  • Drive automation and process improvements to streamline workflows across the accounting function.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to support business decision-making through insightful analysis.

What You Need To Succeed:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Economics or Finance.
  • CRC certification or on track to obtain it.
  • Minimum two years of relevant experience in high-growth tech companies, preferably Banking or FinTech startups; financeira a plus.
  • Solid understanding of accounting procedures and principles (Brazilian GAAP / IFRS a must, BACEN GAAP / COSIF a plus).
  • Keen interest in learning and applying the latest technology to daily work; knowledge and experience with GenAI (e.g., ChatGPT) a must.
  • Experience working with SQL and MS Office/ GSuite packages.
  • Strong Portuguese and English communication skills, both oral and written.
  • Team player with outstanding communication skills in a remote work environment.
  • High level of organizational skills to prioritize & handle multiple tasks on short notice in a face-paced environment.

We are not expecting candidates to have expertise across all of these areas. We will gladly help you bridge the gaps.

As a member of a fully remote and distributed team, you are expected to complete tasks autonomously, being highly collaborative and self-driven.

Diversity and Inclusion

We believe in social inclusion, respect, and appreciation of all people. We promote a welcoming work environment, where each CloudWalker can be authentic, regardless of gender, ethnicity, race, religion, sexuality, mobility, disability, or education.

Advert
Benthic, part of Acteon Group, is a complete end-to-end provider of geotechnical consulting, engineering, design, and data acquisition services. Our vision is to be globally recognized as a provider of best-in-class geotechnical survey and geo-consulting services, admired for our professionalism and ability to create value for all stakeholders.


Benthic is looking to add a highly diligent and meticulous Project Controller to the team. The Project Controller is primarily responsible for working as a support point for the Operational, Financial and Sales teams to ensure financial control over project costs are maintained throughout the execution, from set-up to close-out, of each project. The Project Controller will work with all Operational functions to ensure adequate tracking of project revenues through the monitoring of the project budget or contracts as the scope of work progresses.


The successful candidate will be based in the Rio de Janeiro area.


Please submit Resumes/CVs in English.


Duties

  1. Responsible for financial control of projects including actuals of cost and revenues as well as its monthly forecast, annual budget and for the project cash flow.
  2. Project Accounting analysis & reconciliation.
  3. Responsible for the monthly revenue and cost accruals related to project work.
  4. Controls the projects billings and accounts receivables.
  5. Engage directly with sales and operations to manage project tracking at a project level and aggregate level to ensure proper costing and forecasting of activity (including revenue, costs, and cash).
  6. Advise on any potential issues relating to project cost or revenue, specifically, any significant deviations from forecast or budget.
  7. Assist project teams to ensure variation control, specifically, ensuring that costs associated with additional work that is not part of our contract is being captured and invoiced accordingly.
  8. Liaise with project teams to ensure all sales invoices are raised and payments expedited in a timely manner.
  9. Support the Project Manager with the PMR preparation and report.
  10. Supports the tender manager on financial aspects. Provides input to negotiations on commercial issues. Provides input in local risk review process.
  11. Preparation of business cases and financial feasibility analysis when required.
  12. Work with Financial Manager to ensure revenue forecasts and costing is in place to properly input forecasts into the corporate projections’ files.
  13. Support the Finance team with the closing month process and in assisting with audits.
  14. Maintain accurate files in accordance with agreed standard file structure to ensure ongoing data integrity and compliance.
  15. Assist to ensure complete audits of project costs are actioned as required.
  16. Interface with the finance team at all stages of the project to ensure consistency of information with reporting costs to complete and cash flow forecast.
  17. Adhere strictly to the Company’s policies including, but not limited to, anti-bribery and Foreign Corrupt Practice.

Required

  1. Bachelor’s degree in Accounting; Business administration or Economy.
  2. 5 years’ experience as Project Controller in Oil & Gas industry for EPCI contracts.
  3. Excellent knowledge of accounting and financial rules and processes.
  4. Knowledge in IFRS 15 and POC methodology and application.
  5. Strong MS Excel skills.
  6. Attention to detail and problem-solving ability.
  7. Trustworthy and Ethical.
  8. Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  9. Advanced level in English, both written and spoken.
  10. Must be team-oriented, possess a positive attitude and work well with others.
  11. Ability to competently and professionally present financial reports in meetings with stakeholders, as well as identify and mitigate operational concerns.
  12. Ability to work both independently and within teams.

Job description

QUEM SOMOS?

Prazer, somos a Suzano! Aqui a gente acredita que inovação e sustentabilidade caminham juntas. Dessa união, nasce uma atitude plena de significado: a inovabilidade. Pautados por ela, pensamos fora da caixa e enxergamos longe para lidar com os desafios do século 21. Nós plantamos e cultivamos árvores para transformar essa matéria-prima renovável em Bioprodutos para o dia a dia de mais de 2 bilhões de pessoas.

PLURAL

Iguais e diferentes. Singulares e plurais. Acreditamos que a diversidade nos fortalece, por isso, não fazemos distinção entre candidatos seja por deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar ou estética.

Main responsibilities

DADOS:

GS 16

Local: Rio de Janeiro

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER?

  • Responder pela Ex-Mill, Margem de Contribuição, Volume, Faturamento, Distribuição Numérica e Ponderada - dentre outros indicadores de sua região, assegurando o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas pela companhia;

  • Presença no Mercado (área sob sua responsabilidade) de acordo com a definição do Processo de Vendas, identificando oportunidades e ameaças da concorrência;
  • Aplicar a política comercial Suzano de acordo com a estratégia para a região, canal ou cliente sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Garantir a melhoria contínua do resultado de seus clientes, garantindo assim a manutenção de sua carteira;
  • Estabelecer Planos de Negócios – JBP, para as contas/clientes sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Gerenciar contas e clientes sob sua responsabilidade: monitoramento de estoques, colocação de pedidos, acompanhamento do faturamento, monitoramento das entregas e monitoramento dos pagamentos, entre outras atividades, inerentes a função;
  • Realizar o planejamento colaborativo de Demanda de produtos;
  • Prospectar clientes com potencial e que estejam dentro do perfil de produtos SUZANO;
  • Explorar detalhadamente cada ponto da sua verba off-invoice, quando disponível;
  • Atuar e monitorar o Sell Out nos seus clientes, sugerindo promoções, ações de merchandising ou campanhas que atinjam os consumidores dos seus produtos;
  • Avaliar seu próprio desempenho e propor-se um plano de melhoria operacional continuamente;
  • Ter domínio sobre condições comerciais expressas nos contratos realizados com os clientes de sua carteira.

Requirements and skills

  • Alguém que acredite em nossos valores;
  • Com iniciativa;
  • Perfil analítico;
  • Que proponha ideias e soluções.

O QUE A SUZANO ESPERA DE VOCÊ?

  • Ensino Superior Completo;
  • Disponibilidade de viagens;
  • Desejável conhecimento em: Pacote Office; Matemática Financeira; Alavancas Comerciais; Técnicas de Negociação;
  • Conhecer do mercado e clientes de bens de consumo do mercado/da região;
  • Ter conhecimento dos clientes e varejistas da região de atuação;
  • Ser dinâmico, comunicativo, negociador, proativo, resiliente e com foco em resultados.

Additional information

NÓS TEMOS MUITO MAIS QUE UM PAPEL NA SUA VIDA!

Cuidados da sua saúde: Plano Médico, Odonto e Seguro de Vida; VR ou Refeitório, VA para ajudar nas compras do mercado e, no final do ano, VA adicional; Sabemos que a renda fixa é importante, mas, além disso, oferecemos uma renda extra por meio do nosso Programa de Remuneração Variável (Anual); Para você se preparar para o futuro temos a Previdência privada; Praticamos o home office em áreas corporativas, a flexibilidade de horários, além do dress code casual; Para gerar e compartilhar valor disponibilizamos cursos e treinamentos E-learning em nossa plataforma digital, o UniverSuzano; Na Suzano, só é bom para nós se for bom para o mundo! Por isso, durante o ano realizamos muitas ações legais e você poderá se tornar um voluntário do nosso programa Voluntariar; Também contamos com um Clube de Descontos, com diversos parceiros, para você aproveitar!

PARA A FAMÍLIA

Como empresa cidadã, entendemos a importância da chegada de uma criança. Por isso, oferecemos extensão da licença paternidade para 20 dias e maternidade para 180 dias. O benefício também vale para papais e mamães que adotarem ou obtiverem a guarda judicial da criança e para casais homo afetivos; Para as mamães retornarem tranquilas ao trabalho, oferecemos um auxílio creche bem bacana.

SUZANO FAZ BEM

Você poderá participar do #GrupoDeCorridaSuzano, um projeto pensado para manter a sua saúde em dia; Receber atendimento nutricional; Praticar ginástica laboral; Usar o Gympass na academia de sua preferência, salas com manicure e massagem; Aproveitar o Espaço Faz Bem com mesas de jogos. Nós, da Yara, fazemos parte de uma rede global, colaborando para resolver de forma lucrativa e responsável alguns dos principais desafios do mundo - escassez de recursos, insegurança alimentar e mudanças ambientais.

Apresentação da área

O objetivo da área de Marketing é dar suporte direto aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa através do conhecimento e desenvolvimento de soluções, produtos, tecnologia e serviços, agregando valor ao negócio de nossos clientes, à nossa marca Yara e para a empresa.
 
Aqui, buscamos desenvolver uma relação de longo prazo com canais parceiros, com um olhar atento para entender suas necessidades, desafios e oportunidades e, com base nisso, desenvolver em conjunto estratégias personalizadas para um crescimento sustentável, através de soluções integradas e positivas para a natureza.

Descrição da posição | Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e executar estratégias para relacionamento de longo prazo com canais estratégicos, incentivando o crescimento conjunto e consolidando a Yara como um parceiro confiável;
  • Estruturar modelo e rotinas para acompanhamento recorrente de indicadores de performance em conjunto com canais (sell-in/sell-out);
  • Liderar construção e acompanhamento de JBP, servindo como ponte entre diversas áreas parceiras internas e o cliente;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhorias em serviços, atendimento, investimentos e ações, em linha com a estratégia da companhia, atuando como ponto focal da área para captação de demandas relacionadas;
  • Criar business case para validação de projetos (análise de riscos x oportunidades e potencial de retorno sobre investimento);
  • Desenvolver reports de resultado financeiro de projetos da área (potencial x realizado) e controle de budget para alta liderança;
  • Desenvolver análises de mercado e de oportunidades regionais de negócio, com base em amplo conhecimento sobre a dinâmica de negócios de parceiros-chave;

Perfil | Formação e conhecimentos

  • Espírito de colaboração, protagonismo, curiosidade, senso de dono e respeito às diferenças;
  • Graduação completa em administração, engenharia, economia e áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência de relacionamento com canais de Distribuição do Agro/ key accounts.
  • Experiência em controle de budget e gestão de grandes projetos.
  • Experiência em BI e tratamento de dados.
  • Conhecimento mínimo avançado do idioma Inglês.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel (Macros e VBAs).
  • Conhecimento avançado em Power Point.

Informações adicionais

  • Pós graduação em Marketing e afins será considerado diferencial.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens em território nacional. 

Informações de contato

Conhecimento cultivado com diversidade
A Yara está comprometida em criar um ambiente diverso e inclusivo e se orgulha de ser uma empresa que oferece oportunidades iguais para todos. Acreditamos em um ambiente de trabalho onde nossos colaboradores se sintam à vontade para ser quem são, estimulando a diversidade e a pluralidade de pensamento. Para isso, ancoramos firmemente a Diversidade e Inclusão (D&I) em nossa estratégia de negócio e temos mais de 400 colaboradores em todo o mundo envolvidos como agentes de D&I.

title: Ação policial em Alagoinhas apreende veículo clonado e prende suspeito armado
description:
Ação policial em Alagoinhas apreende veículo clonado e prende suspeito armado

Policiais do 4° BPM, em operação conjunta com o CICOM, prendem suspeito em flagrante com drogas e arma de fogo

Por: Redação

Compartilhe:

Foto: Divulgação/Quarto Batalhão

Na noite deste sábado (28), policiais do 4° Batalhão de Polícia Militar (BPM), durante a execução da Operação Falcão, foram acionados pelo Centro Integrado de Comunicações (CICOM) para verificar a denúncia de um veículo clonado identificado por câmeras de monitoramento na cidade de Alagoinhas. A guarnição iniciou buscas para localizar o Volkswagen Fox de cor preta, e, após algumas rondas, localizou o veículo na praça do Condomínio Linha Verde.

Durante a abordagem, a polícia realizou uma busca pessoal no condutor e também no veículo, encontrando diversos materiais ilícitos. Foram apreendidos um revólver calibre .28 com seis munições, uma porção de substância análoga à cocaína, três trouxinhas de substância análoga à maconha, além de uma ferramenta geralmente utilizada em arrombamentos de veículos.

Suspeito preso em flagrante é apresentado à Delegacia Territorial de Alagoinhas

Diante das evidências, o suspeito foi detido e, juntamente com o material apreendido e o veículo de placa clonada, conduzido à Delegacia Territorial de Alagoinhas. No local, foi lavrado o Auto de Prisão em Flagrante Delito, reforçando o sucesso da operação em combater o crime na região.

A operação segue como parte dos esforços contínuos da Polícia Militar da Bahia para garantir a segurança e a tranquilidade da população de Alagoinhas, intensificando o monitoramento e a repressão ao crime organizado.

* O conteúdo de cada comentário é de responsabilidade de quem realizá-lo. Nos reservamos ao direito de reprovar ou eliminar comentários em desacordo com o propósito do site ou que contenham palavras ofensivas. 500 caracteres restantes. Comentar

Alagoinhas é um município brasileiro do estado da Bahia, localizado no Agreste deste estado. Sua área é de 718,089 quilômetros quadrados e sua população em 2020 era de 152 327 habitantes, tendo portanto uma densidade demográfica de 210,05 habitantes por quilômetro quadrado

Job description

Estamos em busca de um Mecânico de Linha Amarela para se juntar à nossa equipe. O candidato ideal deve possuir habilidades técnicas avançadas e um forte comprometimento com a manutenção e reparo de equipamentos pesados, garantindo a eficiência e a segurança nas operações.


Main responsibilities

Lubrificação Especializada: Realizar a lubrificação precisa e regular de equipamentos de linha amarela, seguindo as especificações do fabricante para garantir a operação eficiente e a longevidade das máquinas.

Inspeção de Equipamentos: Inspecionar e avaliar o estado dos equipamentos, identificando pontos críticos de lubrificação e verificando níveis de óleo e outros fluidos essenciais.

Aplicação de Lubrificantes: Aplicar lubrificantes e outros fluidos de forma eficaz e uniforme em sistemas hidráulicos, motores e componentes das máquinas, utilizando técnicas e ferramentas apropriadas.

Manutenção Preventiva: Executar tarefas de manutenção preventiva relacionadas à lubrificação, garantindo que as máquinas operem dentro das melhores condições possíveis e prevenindo falhas.

Documentação e Relatórios: Manter registros detalhados das atividades de lubrificação, incluindo tipos e quantidades de lubrificante utilizados. Preparar relatórios sobre o estado dos equipamentos e quaisquer necessidades de manutenção adicionais.

Segurança e Procedimentos: Seguir rigorosamente os procedimentos de segurança, incluindo o uso de Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPI) e práticas seguras de manuseio de lubrificantes e produtos químicos.

Colaboração e Comunicação: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com mecânicos e operadores de máquinas para garantir que as necessidades de manutenção sejam atendidas e comunicar quaisquer problemas ou recomendações.


Requirements and skills

Experiência: Experiência comprovada em lubrificação de equipamentos pesados, com foco em máquinas de linha amarela (escavadeiras, retroescavadeiras, tratores, etc.)

Curso: Moop

Carteira Habilitação: Categoria C, D, E

Conhecimento Técnico: Conhecimento profundo dos sistemas de lubrificação e manutenção de equipamentos de linha amarela. Capacidade de seguir manuais técnicos e especificações do fabricante.

Atenção aos Detalhes: Habilidade para identificar áreas que necessitam de lubrificação e detectar sinais de problemas em equipamentos.

Segurança: Comprometimento com as práticas de segurança e uso de Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPI) para garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro.

Comunicação: Boas habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar bem em equipe, colaborando com outros profissionais para garantir a eficiência operacional.

Sistema Fiep é sinônimo de fortalecimento da indústria. Trabalhamos de forma integrada, visando ser referência nacional no desenvolvimento industrial, no apoio ao associativismo e no atendimento eficiente.

Esta é a nossa missão: Promover, representar e defender a indústria paranaense, em busca da melhor competitividade e desenvolvimento sustentável.

Para você que deseja contribuir com o nosso propósito, de transformar o Paraná no melhor lugar para a indústria no Brasil, esta vaga pode ser sua!

Qual é a posição?

Consultor de Conselhos Regionais (Projetos Institucionais de Desenvolvimento Regional) – RP 15148 – FIEP Sede – Curitiba/PR

Quais são os desafios e as principais responsabilidades?

  • Organização da Coordenadoria Regional: O Consultor do Conselho Regional é responsável, em conjunto com o Coordenador Regional, por organizar e coordenar as ações e atividades da coordenadoria, garantindo a convergência de esforços para o desenvolvimento da indústria na região.
  • Mapear e relacionar-se com prefeituras da região, com foco nos departamentos de interesse da indústria (Indústria e Comércio / Inovação / Trabalho / Fazenda);
  • Realização de Fóruns Regionais: Auxiliar no Planejamento, organização e a execução dos fóruns regionais da indústria, que são espaços estratégicos para discussão, troca de experiências e definição de políticas e ações voltadas para o setor.
  • Desmembramento de Atividades: Dividir as atividades dos fóruns regionais em ações específicas, assegurando que cada uma delas esteja alinhada aos objetivos estratégicos da Federação e contribua para o desenvolvimento da indústria local.
  • Apoio Técnico: Prestar apoio técnico da coordenadoria regional, fornecendo suporte especializado para que possam desenvolver suas atividades de forma eficiente e em conformidade com as diretrizes estabelecidas.
  • Interface entre Conselho e Envolvidos: Estabelecer e manter uma comunicação eficaz entre a coordenadoria e todas as partes envolvidas na consecução dos planos de trabalho, garantindo o alinhamento das ações e a efetiva implementação das decisões tomadas nos fóruns regionais.
  • Desenvolvimento de Parcerias: Identificar oportunidades de parcerias estratégicas que possam fortalecer a atuação da Federação na região, promovendo a colaboração entre a indústria, o governo e outros stakeholders relevantes.
  • Monitoramento de Resultados: Acompanhar e avaliar os resultados das atividades realizadas, utilizando indicadores de desempenho para mensurar o impacto das ações na indústria regional e propondo ajustes necessários.
  • Conexão: realizar a interface com as equipes técnicas do Sistema FIEP para atendimento de demandas oriundas das atividades da coordenadoria junto a comunidade industrial e parceiros institucionais.
  • Estar atualizado com as soluções do sistema FIEP, visando gerar oportunidades para o sistema, apresentando, sempre que possível nos fóruns adequados, as soluções do sistema.

Requisitos

Gostou? Então verifique se você possui os requisitos abaixo:

  • Superior completo. Desejável nas áreas de Administração, Economia, Direito, ou áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável especialização em áreas correlatas à Governança Coorporativa, Desenvolvimento Regional.
  • Vivência com Gestão de Projetos, Gestão de negócios, elaboração de planos de trabalho e/ou Relações Institucionais.
  • Experiência em Governança Coorporativa.
  • Experiência em Planejamento.
  • Possuir CNH B e disponibilidade para viagens.
  • Desejável inglês e espanhol intermediário.
  • Candidatos Internos, atender aos critérios de elegibilidade NG 0077 (4.5.4).

description:
O Supermercado Justo deu início a operação no Brasil em outubro de 2021 na cidade de São Paulo e, desde então, o crescimento tem sido constante. Temos como foco principal atender aos interesses e necessidades dos clientes. Nosso objetivo é garantir que todos tenham uma experiência de compra excepcional e diferenciada. O propósito do Justo é entregar produtos de alta qualidade e frescor na casa das pessoas. Nossas frutas e verduras vêm direto do campo, não passam por lojas e são entregues com cuidado. Queremos que nosso cliente sinta que fez suas compras de supermercado pessoalmente.

Os pedidos podem ser feitos pelo site ou app e os clientes têm a opção de agendar o melhor horário para receber a entrega. Garantimos um serviço confiável, seguro e completo. Trabalhamos diretamente com fornecedores locais do campo para garantir que nossos produtos sejam os mais frescos possíveis. Temos um extenso portfólio de produtos e diversas categorias. Você encontra desde itens para limpeza de casa até carnes para o churrasco - o que nos torna um supermercado 100% online e completo.

O compromisso com a sustentabilidade é algo que faz parte do nosso DNA. A escolha por trabalhar com produtores locais, além de garantir os produtos mais frescos, também contribui para a renda familiar desses trabalhadores. Implementamos práticas de negócios éticas e responsáveis. Além da preocupação com as pessoas, nos comprometemos com o meio ambiente, trabalhando na redução do desperdício de alimentos e na eliminação do uso de plásticos na entrega dos pedidos, optando por sacolas de papel e caixas retornáveis.

Acreditamos que nossa combinação única de atendimento ao cliente, produtos frescos e o compromisso com a sustentabilidade nos torna mais que um supermercado - um supermercado como nossos clientes merecem.

Faça parte do time de Heróis de Sangue Amarelo!

Nosso propósito é Tornar o Mundo um Lugar Mais Seguro e não vamos parar até conseguir, pois somos incansáveis e pensamos positivamente.

Com mais de 40 anos de história, presente em 31 países e com mais de 160.000 funcionários em todo o mundo. Somos uma das empresas líderes mundiais do setor de Segurança Privada, que oferece Soluções Integradas de Segurança, adaptadas às necessidades de nossos clientes.

Toda nossa história não seria possível sem um time de heróis e por isso desenvolvemos diariamente programas específicos para atrair novos talentos e promovemos a carreira dos nossos profissionais com treinamentos contínuos e oportunidades internas de crescimento.

Trabalhamos todos os dias para oferecer segurança inovadora com base nas soluções mais avançadas do mercado. Viva uma excelente experiência, participando de um processo seletivo 100% digital, pois temos equipes dedicadas para garantir a qualidade, segurança e humanização em todas as etapas!

Diversidade & Inclusão na Prosegur

Cada um de nós enxerga o mundo de formas diferentes. Mas uma coisa deve ser comum a todos: o respeito. Acreditamos que a diversidade de perspectivas e experiências garantem um ambiente diferenciado de trabalho!

O Programa Somos Todos Heróis - Diversidade e Respeito vem para fortalecer e apoiar o nosso posicionamento a favor do Respeito e da Inclusão e para trazer conhecimento e conscientização a todos os nossos Heróis. Acreditamos que times diversos podem garantir resultados espetaculares além de impulsionar nossa cultura inovadora.

Responsabilidades:

  • Visualizar a área, garantindo a segurança do local, mantendo a atenção quanto à movimentação de pessoas e veículos.

  • Manter postura firme, porém cortês em relação aos clientes e seus funcionários.
  • Fornecer todo tipo de informação e auxílio solicitada por seu superior imediato.
  • Atuar ostensivamente de forma a promover a segurança das pessoas, instalações e materiais, inibindo e coibindo ações prejudiciais aos interesses do cliente, sejam criminosas ou não, obedecendo às prescrições legais.
  • Cumprir as determinações e procedimentos estabelecidos para seu posto de serviço.
  • Elaborar relatórios diários de seu turno/posto de trabalho conforme estabelecidos pela empresa.
  • Responsabilizar-se pela custódia do material a seu cargo (armas, documentação e material do posto).
  • Preencher documentos necessários para o desempenho de sua função (livro de guarda e cartão ponto, por exemplo).
  • Em caso de sinistro atuar proativamente de acordo com os procedimentos, preservando a própria vida e o patrimônio pelo qual está responsável.
  • Demais atividades inerentes à função.

REQUISITOS IMPRESCINDÍVEIS PARA SUA INSCRIÇÃO:

  • Ensino Médio completo ou em curso.

Company Description

ProSidian is a Management and Operations Consulting Services Firm focusing on providing value to clients through tailored solutions based on industry-leading practices. Job Description

ProSidian Seeks a Education Grant Policy Consultant (AER10) (Key Personnel | Program Manager - Exempt 874-1 Consultant) located: CONUS - Atlanta, GA, San Francisco, CA, Austin, TX, Chicago, IL, Washington D.C. (Remote) to provide Education, And Academia Sector related Management And Operations Solutions for Logistical Support for Adult Education Reform Services on behalf of The Department of Education (DoEd). These services are considered part of the ProSidian Education, And Academia Sector Group with relevant Education, And Academia Sector Experience (functional and technical area expertise also ideal) to support an engagement for DOED. under NAICS Code: 541611 - Administrative Management and General Management Consulting Services for The Department of Education with service(s) also characterized as Provide facilitation services for meetings.

JOB OVERVIEW

Serves as a Education Grant Policy Consultant and work as a part of a team to provide Facilitation, and Logistical Support for Adult Education Reform to the Department of Education Office of Career, Technical, and Adult Education (OCTAE) | Division of Adult Education and Literacy (DAEL). The purpose of this task order is to provide subject matter expertise and logistical support to the Department of Education for the production of policy-related materials and a variety of meetings. The ProSidian Engagement Team will identify and procure subject matter experts with knowledge of adult education policy and pedagogy, who will assist in the preparation of commissioned papers, participate in meetings, and provide other services as needed.

Additionally, The ProSidian Engagement Team will provide comprehensive logistical support for planning, conducting, and following up on meetings, including those with up to 150 participants. The order requires adherence to Department of Education publication guidance and compliance, as well as coordination with various federal and non-federal partners. The subject matter experts should have knowledge of Federal policy for adult education, as well as experience and expertise in various subject areas related to adult education. The Department of Education anticipates no more than 10 projects per year, with a total allocated time of 350 person days per year in each option year. Travel is limited to three nights per trip, and subject matter experts (SMEs) hourly pay cannot exceed that of a GS15 Step 10 government employee.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

Responsibilities:

  • Provide expert advice and guidance on education grant policy and related issues
  • Monitor grant opportunities and trends in education funding
  • Analyze complex grant policies and make recommendations for improvement
  • Develop and implement grant solutions to address education challenges
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to develop and implement effective grant strategies
  • Conduct research and analysis on education grant policy and related issues
  • Prepare reports, briefings, and presentations on education grant policy topics

Qualifications

Desired Qualifications For Education Grant Policy Consultant (AER10) | Key Personnel | Program Manager - Exempt 874-1 Consultant Candidates:

Requirements:

  • A Master's degree in Education Policy, Public Policy, or a related field
  • At least 7 years of experience in education grant policy, with a deep understanding of the grant application and review processes
  • Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
  • Experience in grant development and implementation
  • Knowledge of education grant policy issues at the federal, state, and local levels

The ideal candidate is advanced with Excel, Access, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Word, and proficient with Adobe Acrobat, data analytic tools, and Visio with the ability to quickly learn other tools as necessary.

Do you want to help sales of leading cloud solutions in the Life Sciences space? Interested in developing sales and demo skills? At Veeva, we offer excellent opportunities for our people to capitalize on their skills and grow in the dynamic, unique, and exceptional work environment.   • Analyzing and understanding customer requirements
  • Configuring and delivering solution demonstrations

  • Working with cross-functional team members to ensure customer success and deliver value
  • Support marketing activities such as recording videos, presenting webinars, attending conferences
Requirements
  • College Degree (Life science, computer science, or related degree)

  • Experience in pre-sales or similar customer roles for a software company
  • Experience in one of the following areas: Clinical (TMF, CTMS, CRA), Regulatory Affairs, Regulatory Operations or Pharmacovigilance, Quality: Understanding of quality requirements, compliance considerations and processes for Quality process and content management, life sciences compliance, and/or computer systems validation
  • Excellent English communication skills – written, verbal, and formal presentation
  • Ability to act with speed to understand requirements, and create corresponding demonstrations of R&D solutions that meet customer expectations
  • Ability to travel
  • Driven self-starter, able to work independently
Nice to Have
  • Life Science, computer science, or related degree
  • Knowledge of drug development processes
  • SaaS/Cloud solutions and software technology experience
  • Experience in consulting or project implementation
  • Master’s Degree
  • Experience with software solutions for at least one of the following systems:
  • Clinical trials systems: Direct experience with systems such as DataTrak, Oracle Siebel, goBalto, BioClinica CTMS, Medidata Rave CTMS/Strategic Monitoring, Parexel IMPACT, Bio-Optronics Clinical Conductor, PhlexEView, Trial Interactive, DrugDev Site Selection and Payments, WingSpan eTMF and SiteZONE, Complion, Florence eBinders, Forte Oncore and eReg, Veeva Vault, NextDocs, Documentum, other clinical technologies
  • Regulatory systems: Direct experience with systems such as Veeva Vault, Organex, Ultreia, Lorenz, PAREXEL/LIQUE NT, Insight, CSC Regulatory Tracker, ArisGlobal Register, and other regulatory information management or submissions systems.
  • Quality systems: Veeva Vault, SoftExpert, ETQ Reliance, TrackWise, OpenText, MasterControl, SharePoint, Documentum, FirstDoc FirstPoint, NextDocs, UL ComplianceWire, and other quality information management or content management systems

description:
A EMPRESAS REVEMAR está em busca de um profissional dinâmico e comprometido para a posição de Entregador Técnico em nossa empresa. Se você possui habilidades de comunicação excepcionais, talento para atender clientes e é apaixonado por entregar excelência, essa pode ser a oportunidade perfeita para você.


Como Entregador Técnico, você será responsável por realizar entregas precisas e garantir a satisfação dos clientes. Além disso, você será responsável por:

  1. Receber e conferir as mercadorias antes de realizar as entregas;
  2. Organizar e planejar a rota de entrega, garantindo a eficiência do processo;
  3. Atender os clientes de forma cortês e profissional, solucionando eventuais problemas ou dúvidas;
  4. Zelar pela integridade das mercadorias durante o transporte;
  5. Manter o veículo limpo e em bom estado de conservação.

Para se destacar nessa posição, é essencial que o candidato possua um conjunto de habilidades e atitudes.


Principais habilidades requeridas:

  1. Dinamismo: É necessário ter agilidade e flexibilidade para lidar com diferentes situações durante as entregas. Ser capaz de se adaptar a mudanças de última hora é fundamental.
  2. Comunicação: A habilidade de se comunicar de forma clara e eficaz é indispensável. É importante saber se expressar com clareza e transmitir informações aos clientes e colegas de equipe.
  3. Atendimento ao Cliente: Ter habilidades de atendimento ao cliente é essencial para garantir a satisfação dos clientes. O candidato deve ser capaz de lidar com reclamações e solucionar problemas, sempre buscando a melhor experiência para o cliente.
  4. Comprometimento: É importante ser comprometido com a empresa e com o cumprimento dos prazos de entrega. Um entregador técnico deve ser pontual e responsável para garantir a confiança dos clientes.

Além disso, é necessário possuir CNH válida na categoria B e ter experiência comprovada na função de entregador técnico. Também valorizamos candidatos que tenham conhecimento em manuseio de produtos técnicos.


Nós, da EMPRESAS REVEMAR, oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, oportunidades de crescimento e remuneração competitiva. Se você se encaixa no perfil descrito e está pronto para se juntar a uma empresa líder em seu segmento, envie seu currículo o mais breve possível.

Por: Redação

Compartilhe:

Foto: Reprodução / Redes sociais

Um adolescente de 17 anos morreu, neste sábado (28), após ser vítima de um afogamento na praia de Piatã , em Salvador , próximo a um supermercado. A Polícia Civil confirmou a tragédia, que chocou os frequentadores do local.

Morte confirmada pelo Samu

A vítima, identificada como Igor Aimar Conceição de Oliveira , foi atendida por uma equipe do Serviço de Atendimento Móvel de Urgência (Samu) , que constatou o óbito. Até o momento, não foram divulgadas informações sobre as circunstâncias que levaram ao afogamento.

Polícia Civil apura circunstâncias do afogamento

Em nota oficial, a 12ª Delegacia Territorial (DT/Itapuã) informou que está investigando o caso para apurar o que motivou a morte do adolescente. O incidente aconteceu em uma área movimentada da praia de Piatã , aumentando a atenção das autoridades locais.

title: Property Specialist, Senior
description:
The Property Specialist, Senior

The Property Specialist, Senior will be based at one of three Amentum sites in Iraq and serve the Operations and Maintenance Support Services (OMSS) contract in support of the U.S. Department of State. This position, under general supervision, will ensure that Government property is properly identified and tracked from acquisition to disposition. This position collaborates with and reports to the Logistics Manager to schedule and resolve inventory discrepancies. The duties and responsibilities listed below are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all inclusive.

DUTIES:

  1. Responsible for maintaining a safe workplace and ensuring that safety is the highest priority in the workplace.
  2. Comply with all Environmental Health & Safety and Quality Assurance requirements and goals.
  3. Provide information and materials to these divisions as necessary to ensure adequate and legal documentation.
  4. Ensure that property records are accessible and appropriately controlled and maintained consistent with the nature of the business, property type, applicable policies and procedures, and customer requirements.
  5. Minimize administrative cost by using common processes when possible.
  6. Develop and execute plans to inventory accountable property. The frequency and method of inventory may vary based on property type and established practices.
  7. Ensure that subcontract agreements address property to be furnished to or acquired by subcontractors or other elements and include appropriate property management requirements.
  8. Assess subcontractor property control systems to provide reasonable assurance that accountable property is managed in accordance with subcontract terms and conditions.
  9. Administer and manage physical inventories of Government Property.
  10. Work closely with lower-level Property Staff and Property Custodians to ensure overall accountability of assets.
  11. Mentor lower-level Property Staff and custodians in proper process and procedures as they relate to Government Property.
  12. Identify problem areas and recommend viable solutions.
  13. Perform physical inventories of Government Furnished Property (GFP) and Contractor Acquired Property (CAP), as directed by the Logistics and Property Manager.
  14. Assign Government Property Identification numbers (GP), prepare required schedule, and assist with identifying Lost, Damaged, & Destroyed property as well as excessive consumption.
  15. Track and record movement of all types of Government property. This includes movement from one point to another within a contractor’s facility, movement between facilities, for any purpose, and protection during movement.
  16. Assist on the preparation and safeguarding of administrative support files.
  17. Prepare hand receipts for all property custodian/hand receipt holders.
  18. Ensure compliance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), Statement of Work (SOW) and Standard Operating Procedures (SOP).
  19. Complete routine spot checks of site assets.
  20. Maintain logs and status records to include lost, damaged, or destroyed items.
  21. Check LTDD packages for accuracy and completion.
  22. Assist with all other Logistics Warehouse duties as assigned.

REQUIRED:

  1. Minimum Acceptable Experience Level: Background in property and/or materials management.
  2. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
  3. Knowledge of the FAR and industry leading practices regarding Government Property.
  4. Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions and decimals.
  5. Collect data, define problems, and propose solutions.
  6. Understand how inventory affects company contractual obligations.
  7. Ability to clearly and concisely articulate services/requirements in writing.
  8. Ability to articulate in a clear and concise manner with Management and Trades Departments on a daily basis.
  9. Ability to lift materials and equipment weighing up to 50 lbs.
  10. Ability to demonstrate analytical skills, researching skills.
  11. Ability to efficiently and effectively perform the technical requirements.
  12. Excellent organizational and time management skills, with ability to prioritize effectively and work with a sense of urgency.
  13. Ability to read, interpret and follow all Amentum /Logistic Management procedures, policies and guidelines.
  14. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions.
  15. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment that requires handling multiple tasks at a given time and rapidly adapting to changing priorities and schedules.
  16. Education: A high school diploma or GED. An undergraduate degree is preferred but can be replaced with additional years of Government Property Administration.
  17. Passport, Licenses and Certifications: As part of pre-contingency requirements, by the time the visa process starts, candidates must possess a valid passport with a minimum of 18 months remaining to expiration date with 8 blank pages. Valid drivers’ license from Home of Record.
  18. Security Vetting: Already possess a Moderate Risk Public Trust (MRPT) or be able to obtain a favorable MRPT certification prior to being hired is required for the position. Must maintain eligibility at the required certification level for the duration of the contract.
  19. Language Skills: Satisfactory English proficiency to meet job requirements and to adhere and comply with safety, health, and security measures.
  20. Medical: Successfully complete and pass the medical and dental examinations as required by Amentum and our customer for deployment to Iraq. Must maintain physical and dental requirements for duration of deployment.

DESIRED:

  1. Previous out of home country experience is highly desirable and previous work experience in harsh environmental conditions is a plus.
  2. Experience working with Amentum /PAE.

OTHER KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

  1. Knowledge of ALL principles and processes involved in operating and supporting supply chain functions at a large-scale overseas facility.
  2. Experience providing excellent customer services.
  3. Cross-cultural sensitivity with an international perspective.
  4. Excellent organizational and time management skills.
  5. Expert computer skills, specifically in Microsoft Word and Excel.
  6. Ability to become an active and functioning member of a team.
  7. Must have the ability to be innovative and be an agent for change.
  8. Expert communication skills to facilitate and disseminate information.

Auditor III

111675

Zurich is one of the world’s leading insurance groups, and one of the few to operate on a global basis. Our mission is to help our customers understand and protect themselves from risk. With about 55,000 employees serving customers in more than 215 countries, we aspire to become the best global insurer as measured by our shareholders, customers and employees. We help individuals, small and medium sized companies and global corporations around the world understand and protect themselves from risk by offering a wide range of insurance products, solutions and advisory services.

Our people are the heart & soul of Zurich. Together we are committed to delivering on our purpose - Let’s Create a Brighter Future Together! Our ambition is to become one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world. To get there we hire and develop the best talent available. With Zurich, you can expect to work on challenges that will help you grow and to collaborate with a diverse and inclusive global team.

So make a difference. Be challenged. Be inspired. Be supported, Love what you do. Work for us.

Our audit team is growing!

Being a Group Auditor at Zurich means being part of a community of internal auditors with a common purpose: to keep Zurich safe. We are an international team of 240+ colleagues from 33 different nationalities, working as one function from Chicago to Sydney! Together, we look to bring our skills, capabilities and unique strengths to provide insights to our stakeholders.

We are at the start of a journey to transform our way of working, to be more agile and fit for whatever the future brings, with increased autonomy and faster decision-making. We believe that a clear common purpose, promoting authenticity of individuals and creating a learning environment will help our teams bring their best.

As part of this journey, we’re growing our audit team and are looking for talented individuals to assist in the delivery of audits in the Latam region. If you want to make a change for Zurich through audit responses to industry challenges and are familiar with any technical insurance field within the Property & Casualty, Commercial Insurance, Life Insurance, Finance, or Actuarial processes, we have a role waiting for you!

The opportunity: Senior Auditor

Your role

We are looking for a Senior Auditor to join our audit team in Brazil. In this role, you will be responsible for providing insights to the business through the execution of audit projects. With the support of the Audit Manager, you will develop an understanding of the business and its risks, co-develop audit approaches and report audit outcomes. You will interact with teams across Europe, North America, Latin America and Asia-Pacific. This opportunity offers an international learning platform where you will share audit experience and knowledge, learn about new audit approaches and help build your career.

As a Senior Auditor your main responsibilities will involve:

  • Developing own knowledge and business awareness and building business relationships
  • Keep the business safe by delivering relevant local and global audits, working together with the Audit Manager in determining the audit scope, risks to be addressed and most appropriate audit techniques (including data analytics)
  • Taking ownership of your audit work, applying your professional judgement, documenting, and reporting results in line with Group Audit standards and methodologies
  • Influencing the business by agreeing actions and delivering the final audit report, with support from the Senior Manager or Audit Manager, when needed
  • Contributing to the Group Audit global team through sharing own technical knowledge and engaging in our continuous training program.

Your skills and experience

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field or professional qualification – Actuarial science is a differential
  • Experience in Audit / Risk Management / Compliance, or experience in first line roles in an insurance related field
  • Knowledge of Internal Audit Standards, internal control framework and audit testing
  • Ability to interact with stakeholders from all seniority levels and build business relationships
  • Excellent project management skills, ability to organize own tasks and deliver on time to high quality standards
  • Capacity to work in a fast-paced and multicultural environment with initiative to manage multiple competing tasks
  • Good verbal and written communication skills (English). Additional languages are advantageous.
  • Experience in applying data analytics
  • Great team player with ability to work independently when necessary
  • Passion and enthusiasm to continue to grow yourself and others around you

Acreditamos que a cooperação é a chave para a inovação. Aqui no Sicredi nos preocupamos em criar um ambiente diverso e inclusivo, e trazer a consciência da importância da diversidade para desconstruir padrões.

Evoluímos constantemente e mantemos a essência do cooperativismo para superar as barreiras, conquistar novos horizontes e desenvolver a sociedade com maior inclusão, diversidade e equidade.

Não é à toa que somos a Melhor Empresa para se Trabalhar no Brasil 2024 , segundo a GPTW!

title: Structured Products Onboarding Analyst
description:
About Marex

Marex Group plc is a diversified global financial services platform, providing essential liquidity, market access and infrastructure services to clients in the energy, commodities and financial markets. It listed on Nasdaq Global Select Market in April 2024. With more than 35 offices in Europe, US and APAC, it has unique access across markets with significant share globally both on and off exchange. The depth of knowledge amongst its teams and divisions provides its customers with clear advantage, and its technology-led service provides access to all major exchanges, order-flow management via screen, voice and DMA, plus award-winning data, insights and analytics.

Marex Solutions, a division of Marex, is a specialist producer of tailored OTC derivatives and structured products. We are a highly entrepreneurial and fast growing manufacturer, trader and service provider of customised derivative solutions. We design and implement solutions to mitigate against market risks or to create investment opportunities. We leverage cutting edge technology to empower our customers and disrupt traditional investment banking practices.

For more information visit

Role Summary

The Onboarding Analyst will be mainly focused on guaranteeing, from a 2nd line of defence perspective, that the mandatory KYC processes are followed.

Responsibilities

  • Performing and analysing background checks, adverse media screening for identification of reputational risks for the firm;
  • Performing review of KYC forms prepared by the Operations team during client on boarding process and periodic reviews according to high standards established by Marex Solutions;
  • Performing clients risk assessments based on Marex Solutions KYC requirements, applicable policies, market best practices, and KYC laws, regulation and requirements;
  • Registration of customer data in internal systems.
  • Providing advice on KYC requirements and ad-hoc requests and queries from Relationship Managers and Account Managers;
  • Work closely and partner with finance, risk, audit, quality control and compliance departments
  • Adhere to the operational risk framework for your role ensuring that all regulatory or company determined parameters are complied with.
  • Role model for demonstrating highest level standards of integrity and conduct and reflecting Company Values.
  • At all times complying with the FCA’s Code of Conduct and Marex’s Code of Conduct
  • To ensure that you are fully aware of and adhere to internal policies that relate to you, your role or any other activities for which you have any level of responsibility
  • To report any breaches of policy to Compliance and/ or your supervisor as required
  • To escalate risk events immediately

Skills and Experience

  • Adept across the MS Office suite (the ability to write macros/VBA and Python is highly desirable)
  • Keen to work in a rapidly evolving and growing organisation and make your mark, highly committed
  • Problem solving skills
  • A meticulous eye for detail
  • Fluent in English

Competencies

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • A collaborative team player, approachable, self-efficient and influences a positive work environment
  • Demonstrates curiosity
  • Detail oriented
  • Resilient in a challenging, fast-paced environment

Conduct Rules

You must:

  • Act with integrity
  • Act with due skill, care and diligence
  • Be open and cooperative with the FCA, the PRA and other regulators
  • Pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly
  • Observe proper standard of market conduct
  • Act to deliver good outcomes for retail customers

Company Values

Acting as a role model for the values of the Company:

Respect - Clients are at the heart of our business, with superior execution and superb client service the foundation of the firm. We respect our clients and always treat them fairly.

Integrity - Doing business the right way is the only way. We hold ourselves to a high ethical standard in everything we do – our clients expect this and we demand it of ourselves.

Collaborative - We work in teams - open and direct communication and the willingness to work hard and collaboratively are the basis for effective teamwork. Working well with others is necessary for us to succeed at what we do.

Developing our People - Our people are the basis of our competitive advantage. We look to “grow our own” and make Marex the place ambitious, hardworking, talented people choose to build their careers.

Adaptable and Nimble - Our size and flexibility is an advantage. We are big enough to support our client’s various needs, and adaptable and nimble enough to respond quickly to changing conditions or requirements. A non-bureaucratic, but well controlled environment fosters initiative as well as employee satisfaction.

Marex is fully committed to the elimination of unlawful or unfair discrimination and values the differences that a diverse workforce brings to the company.

Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Finance at TRACTIAN

The Finance team at TRACTIAN is responsible for managing the company’s financial health and ensuring sustainable growth. This team oversees financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and analysis, ensuring that all departments have the resources they need to operate efficiently. They also manage financial reporting and compliance, working closely with other departments to ensure alignment with the company’s strategic goals. Finance is key to driving profitability, managing cash flow, and ensuring that TRACTIAN maintains a healthy financial foundation as it scales.

What you'll do

As a Fiscal Analyst, you will be responsible for managing the operational processes related to auxiliary tax obligations and addressing day-to-day fiscal challenges. In this role, you will ensure compliance with Brazilian tax regulations while identifying and implementing optimizations to improve efficiency and accuracy in the fiscal area. This is a hands-on position where you will balance routine operational tasks with strategic process improvements.

  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to maintain up-to-date knowledge of fiscal policies and requirements.
  • Identify and implement opportunities for optimization in fiscal processes, improving efficiency and accuracy.

,

title: Structured Products Onboarding Analyst
description:
Marex Group plc is a diversified global financial services platform, providing essential liquidity, market access and infrastructure services to clients in the energy, commodities and financial markets. It listed on Nasdaq Global Select Market in April 2024. With more than 35 offices in Europe, US and APAC, it has unique access across markets with significant share globally both on and off exchange. The depth of knowledge amongst its teams and divisions provides its customers with clear advantage, and its technology-led service provides access to all major exchanges, order-flow management via screen, voice and DMA, plus award-winning data, insights and analytics.

Marex Solutions, a division of Marex, is a specialist producer of tailored OTC derivatives and structured products. We are a highly entrepreneurial and fast growing manufacturer, trader and service provider of customised derivative solutions. We design and implement solutions to mitigate against market risks or to create investment opportunities. We leverage cutting edge technology to empower our customers and disrupt traditional investment banking practices.

The Onboarding Analyst will be mainly focused on guaranteeing, from a 2nd line of defence perspective, that the mandatory KYC processes are followed.

Responsibilities

  • Performing and analysing background checks, adverse media screening for identification of reputational risks for the firm;
  • Performing review of KYC forms prepared by the Operations team during client onboarding process and periodic reviews according to high standards established by Marex Solutions;
  • Performing clients risk assessments based on Marex Solutions KYC requirements, applicable policies, market best practices, and KYC laws, regulation and requirements;
  • Registration of customer data in internal systems.
  • Providing advice on KYC requirements and ad-hoc requests and queries from Relationship Managers and Account Managers;
  • Work closely and partner with finance, risk, audit, quality control and compliance departments;
  • Adhere to the operational risk framework for your role ensuring that all regulatory or company determined parameters are complied with.
  • Role model for demonstrating highest level standards of integrity and conduct and reflecting Company Values.
  • At all times complying with the FCA’s Code of Conduct and Marex’s Code of Conduct.
  • To ensure that you are fully aware of and adhere to internal policies that relate to you, your role or any other activities for which you have any level of responsibility.
  • To report any breaches of policy to Compliance and/or your supervisor as required.
  • To escalate risk events immediately.

Skills and Experience

  • Adept across the MS Office suite (the ability to write macros/VBA and Python is highly desirable).
  • Keen to work in a rapidly evolving and growing organisation and make your mark, highly committed.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • A collaborative team player, approachable, self-efficient and influences a positive work environment.
  • Detail oriented.
  • Resilient in a challenging, fast-paced environment.

Conduct Rules

You must:

  • Act with integrity.
  • Act with due skill, care and diligence.
  • Be open and cooperative with the FCA, the PRA and other regulators.
  • Pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly.
  • Observe proper standard of market conduct.

Company Values

Acting as a role model for the values of the Company:

Respect – Clients are at the heart of our business, with superior execution and superb client service the foundation of the firm. We respect our clients and always treat them fairly.

Integrity
– Doing business the right way is the only way. We hold ourselves to a high ethical standard in everything we do – our clients expect this and we demand it of ourselves.

Collaborative
– We work in teams – open and direct communication and the willingness to work hard and collaboratively are the basis for effective teamwork. Working well with others is necessary for us to succeed at what we do.

Developing our People
– Our people are the basis of our competitive advantage. We look to “grow our own” and make Marex the place ambitious, hardworking, talented people choose to build their careers.

Adaptable and Nimble
– Our size and flexibility is an advantage. We are big enough to support our client’s various needs, and adaptable and nimble enough to respond quickly to changing conditions or requirements. A non-bureaucratic, but well controlled environment fosters initiative as well as employee satisfaction.

Marex is fully committed to the elimination of unlawful or unfair discrimination and values the differences that a diverse workforce brings to the company.

title: Policial penal da penitenciária de Dourados fica preso e outro ganha liberdade
description:
Policial penal da penitenciária de Dourados fica preso e outro ganha liberdade

Ambos haviam sido presos por tráfico de drogas e armas na última quinta-feira (19)

A Justiça converteu em preventiva a prisão em flagrante do policial penal, Robson Magno Haveroth, preso na última quinta-feira (19), com maconha, cocaína e munições, na Penitenciária Estadual de Dourados (PED) por equipe do Departamento de Repressão à Corrupção e ao Crime Organizado (Dracco). Já o colega, também preso na mesma data, Iran Alberto Coelho Misael foi liberado da prisão, ontem (21).

O juiz de direito em substituição da 1º Vara Criminal de Dourados, Alessandro Leite Pereira, converteu a prisão em flagrante para prisão preventiva. O magistrado considerou que os policiais civis verificaram, por meio de câmeras de segurança, Robson entrando na unidade prisional levando mochila com 2,112 gramas de maconha e 2,144 gramas de cocaína, além de munições.

“No auto de prisão em flagrante denota-se que o autuado Robson Magno Haveroth foi preso em uma das situações do artigo 302 do Código de Processo Penal, tendo a autoridade policial observado os mandamentos do artigo 304 do Código de Processo Penal. Destarte, homologo o flagrante por se encontrar formal e materialmente em ordem”, relata parte do documento assinado pelo magistrado.

Ainda na decisão o juiz relatou que em relação ao policial penal Iran, não dispõe de elementos convincentes que comprovem sua participação no crime. “Ainda assim, ele seguirá sob medidas cautelares de acompanhamento”.

De acordo com Dracco, drogas e munições estavam na mochila de Robson, no momento em que ele entrava na Penitenciária Estadual de Dourados, por volta das 00h30. Já Iran estava na portaria, na função de vistoria, porém teria facilitado a passagem da mochila.

A prisão é resultado de ação conjunta realizada pela Dracco e Agência Estadual de Administração do Sistema Penitenciário (Agepen).

The Role

As a Principal Geoscience Consultant, you will provide onsite and remote workflow support, training in seismic processing and imaging services, and consulting for a major Oil & Gas client. Your goal will be to enhance their depth imaging objectives using AspenTech’s advanced velocity model building, seismic imaging, and seismic characterization technologies. You will also conduct project work on behalf of the client.

Your Impact

  • Collaborate with clients to solve complex subsurface imaging challenges using cutting-edge software and ensure successful project execution with high customer satisfaction.
  • Work closely with AspenTech’s senior technical team and the client’s seismic processing team to optimize seismic data preparation for velocity model building and depth imaging.

  • Monitor contractual obligations, including billing, and proactively communicate gaps to management.
  • Publish accurate and timely weekly and project reports.
  • Act as a subject matter expert to ensure projects are completed successfully and on time.

What You'll Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in Geophysics, Geosciences, or a Master’s degree in Geophysics (preferred in lieu of experience).
  • At least 8 years of experience in seismic processing and imaging, with 3+ years specializing in velocity model building and depth imaging in offshore environments.
  • Expertise in narrow, multi-azimuth, wide azimuth, and Ocean Bottom Nodal seismic data.
  • Proficiency in seismic processing and velocity model building software such as GeoDepth or equivalents.
  • Advanced English communication skills; proficiency in a third regional language is a plus.
  • Strong project management and leadership skills are desirable.
  • Ability to travel minimally if required.

This is an excellent opportunity to leverage your geophysical expertise to deliver impactful solutions and drive success for AspenTech and its clients.
